-- Geometria compartilhada. Não decide captura; cliente e servidor usam o mesmo alcance.
local Aim = {}
function Aim.Range(lasso, power)
	return lasso.MinimumRange + (lasso.MaximumRange - lasso.MinimumRange) * math.clamp(power, 0, 1)
end
function Aim.Origin(character)
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	return root and root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.3, 0)
end
function Aim.Params(excluded)
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = excluded
	return params
end
function Aim.Creature(instance, wildFolder)
	local current = instance
	while current and current.Parent ~= wildFolder do
		current = current.Parent
	end
	return current and current:IsA("Model") and current or nil
end
function Aim.Resolve(origin, ray, range, params, rayLength)
	local cameraHit = workspace:Raycast(ray.origin, ray.direction.Unit * rayLength, params)
	local point = cameraHit and cameraHit.Position or ray.origin + ray.direction.Unit * rayLength
	local delta = point - origin
	local direction = delta.Magnitude > 0.01 and delta.Unit or ray.direction.Unit
	local distance = math.min(delta.Magnitude, range)
	if distance < 0.05 then
		distance = 0.05
	end
	-- Um obstáculo entre a mão e o ponto mirado interrompe o percurso.
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction * distance, params)
	return {
		origin = origin,
		direction = direction,
		distance = hit and (hit.Position - origin).Magnitude or distance,
		endpoint = hit and hit.Position or origin + direction * distance,
		hit = hit,
		cameraHit = cameraHit,
		withinRange = delta.Magnitude <= range + 0.01,
	}
end
return Aim

-- Objetos visuais sem colisão; usados para carregar, voar, recolher e confirmar impacto.
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local Config = require(script.Parent.CaptureConfig)
local V = {}
local function part(parent, name, size, color)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = name
	p.Size = size
	p.Color = color
	p.Anchored = true
	p.CanCollide = false
	p.CanTouch = false
	p.CanQuery = false
	p.CastShadow = false
	p.Parent = parent
	return p
end
function V.Loop(parent)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "LacoArremessado"
	local center = part(model, "Centro", Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1), Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
	center.Transparency = 1
	model.PrimaryPart = center
	for i = 1, 20 do
		local angle = i * math.pi / 10
		local piece = part(model, "Corda", Vector3.new(0.14, 0.38, 0.14), Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 70))
		piece.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		piece.CFrame = CFrame.new(math.cos(angle) * Config.LoopRadius, math.sin(angle) * Config.LoopRadius, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, angle)
	end
	model.Parent = parent
	return model
end
function V.Line(character, part)
	local hand = character
		and (
			character:FindFirstChild("RightHand")
			or character:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
			or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		)
	if not hand then
		return nil
	end
	local from = Instance.new("Attachment")
	from.Name = "HACLacoOrigem"
	from.Parent = hand
	local to = Instance.new("Attachment")
	to.Name = "HACLacoPonta"
	to.Parent = part
	local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
	beam.Name = "CordaDoLaco"
	beam.Attachment0 = from
	beam.Attachment1 = to
	beam.Width0 = 0.12
	beam.Width1 = 0.12
	beam.FaceCamera = true
	beam.Segments = 12
	beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 218, 100))
	beam.LightEmission = 0.2
	beam.Parent = from
	return { from = from, to = to, beam = beam }
end
function V.CleanupLine(line)
	if not line then
		return
	end
	line.from:Destroy()
	line.to:Destroy()
end
function V.Burst(parent, position, color, count)
	for i = 1, count do
		local angle = math.pi * 2 * i / count
		local spark = part(parent, "ImpactoLaco", Vector3.new(0.16, 0.16, 0.16), color)
		spark.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		spark.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		spark.Position = position
		TweenService:Create(spark, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Position = position + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * 1.7, 0.4 + (i % 3) * 0.25, math.sin(angle) * 1.7),
			Transparency = 1,
			Size = Vector3.new(0.03, 0.03, 0.03),
		}):Play()
		Debris:AddItem(spark, 0.35)
	end
end
return V

}
WorldStyle.Surfaces = {
	Gramado = { material = "HAC_Studs", color = Color3.fromRGB(131, 245, 68) },
	Terra = { material = "HAC_Studs", color = Color3.fromRGB(238, 171, 91) },
	Copa = { material = "HAC_Leaves", color = Color3.fromRGB(59, 214, 83) },
	Tronco = { material = "HAC_ToyWood", color = Color3.fromRGB(233, 159, 77) },
	PostePonte = { material = "HAC_ToyWood", color = Color3.fromRGB(233, 159, 77) },
	Ponte = { material = "HAC_ToyWood", color = Color3.fromRGB(246, 192, 109) },
	Caminho = { material = "HAC_Tiles", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 238, 170) },
	Rocha = { material = "HAC_Studs", color = Color3.fromRGB(157, 131, 248) },
}
function WorldStyle.Apply(world)
	local count = 0
	for _, part in ipairs(world:GetDescendants()) do
		local spec = part:IsA("BasePart") and WorldStyle.Surfaces[part.Name]
		if spec then
			if not part:GetAttribute("HACOriginalMaterial") then
				part:SetAttribute("HACOriginalMaterial", part.Material.Name)
				part:SetAttribute("HACOriginalVariant", part.MaterialVariant)
				part:SetAttribute("HACOriginalColor", part.Color)
				part:SetAttribute("HACOriginalTopSurface", part.TopSurface.Name)
			end
			part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			part.MaterialVariant = ""
			part.Color = spec.color
			part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
			local textureSpec = WorldStyle.Materials[spec.material]
			local faces = (part.Name == "Gramado" or part.Name == "Caminho") and { Enum.NormalId.Top }
				or Enum.NormalId:GetEnumItems()
			for _, face in ipairs(faces) do
				local name = "HAC_Texture_" .. face.Name
				local texture = part:FindFirstChild(name)
				if not texture then
					texture = Instance.new("Texture")
					texture.Name = name
					texture.Parent = part
				end
				texture.Face = face
				texture.Texture = textureSpec.image
				texture.StudsPerTileU = textureSpec.tile
				texture.StudsPerTileV = textureSpec.tile
				texture.Color3 = spec.color
				texture.Transparency = 0
			end
			count += 1
		end
	end
	return count
end
function WorldStyle.Restore(world)
	for _, part in ipairs(world:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and part:GetAttribute("HACOriginalMaterial") then
			for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("Texture") and child.Name:match("^HAC_Texture_") then
					child:Destroy()
				end
			end
			part.Material = Enum.Material[part:GetAttribute("HACOriginalMaterial")]
			part.MaterialVariant = part:GetAttribute("HACOriginalVariant")
			part.Color = part:GetAttribute("HACOriginalColor")
			part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType[part:GetAttribute("HACOriginalTopSurface")]
		end
	end
end
return WorldStyle

-- Mesmas regras geométricas na prévia e no servidor; apenas o servidor consome itens.
local C = require(script.Parent.GameplayConfig)
local Placement = {}
function Placement.Resolve(position, rootPosition, ground, params, occupied)
	local rules = C.Placement
	if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" or position.X ~= position.X or position.Y ~= position.Y or position.Z ~= position.Z
		or (position - rootPosition).Magnitude > rules.Distance then
		return nil, "Escolha o chão a até " .. rules.Distance .. " studs."
	end
	if not ground then return nil, "Área de caça indisponível." end
	local point = ground.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
	if math.abs(point.X) > ground.Size.X / 2 - rules.Border or math.abs(point.Z) > ground.Size.Z / 2 - rules.Border then
		return nil, "Use na área de caça."
	end
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0), Vector3.new(0, -10, 0), params)
	if not hit or hit.Instance ~= ground or hit.Normal.Y < 0.9 then return nil, "Posicione em chão livre." end
	if (hit.Position - rootPosition).Magnitude > rules.Distance then return nil, "Aproxime-se do local escolhido." end
	local sight = workspace:Raycast(rootPosition, hit.Position - rootPosition, params)
	if sight and sight.Instance ~= ground then return nil, "Há um obstáculo no caminho." end
	local placed = hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, rules.Height, 0)
	for _, part in ipairs(occupied) do
		if part.Parent and (part.Position - placed).Magnitude < rules.Spacing then return nil, "Muito perto de outra ferramenta." end
	end
	return placed
end
return Placement

-- Apenas este módulo decide carga, trajetória, acerto e resultado da captura.
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local CaptureService = {}
CaptureService.__index = CaptureService

local function finiteVector(value)
	return typeof(value) == "Vector3"
		and value.X == value.X
		and value.Y == value.Y
		and value.Z == value.Z
		and math.abs(value.X) < 100000
		and math.abs(value.Y) < 100000
		and math.abs(value.Z) < 100000
end

local function playerRoot(player)
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return nil
	end
	return character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function equippedLasso(player)
	local tool = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	return tool and Config.Lassos[tool.Name], tool and tool.Name
end

local function tether(player, creature)
	local character = player.Character
	local hand = character
		and (
			character:FindFirstChild("RightHand")
			or character:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
			or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		)
	local target = creature.PrimaryPart
	if not hand or not target then
		return nil
	end
	local from = Instance.new("Attachment")
	from.Name = "HACLacoOrigem"
	from.Parent = hand
	local to = Instance.new("Attachment")
	to.Name = "HACLacoAlvo"
	to.Parent = target
	local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
	beam.Name = "LacoEmDisputa"
	beam.Attachment0 = from
	beam.Attachment1 = to
	beam.Width0 = 0.16
	beam.Width1 = 0.16
	beam.Segments = 10
	beam.FaceCamera = true
	beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 122))
	beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.12)
	beam.Parent = from
	return { from = from, to = to, beam = beam }
end

local function rewardBurst(parent, position, golden)
	local colors = golden
			and { Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 75), Color3.fromRGB(255, 247, 190), Color3.fromRGB(255, 146, 75) }
		or { Color3.fromRGB(68, 222, 242), Color3.fromRGB(255, 219, 102), Color3.fromRGB(111, 238, 160) }
	for i = 1, golden and 20 or 14 do
		local angle = i * math.pi * 2 / (golden and 20 or 14)
		local spark = Instance.new("Part")
		spark.Name = "BrilhoCaptura"
		spark.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		spark.Size = Vector3.new(0.42, 0.42, 0.42)
		spark.Color = colors[(i - 1) % #colors + 1]
		spark.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		spark.Anchored = true
		spark.CanCollide = false
		spark.CanTouch = false
		spark.CanQuery = false
		spark.Position = position
		spark.Parent = parent
		local distance = golden and 5.5 or 3.8
		TweenService:Create(spark, TweenInfo.new(0.72, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Position = position
				+ Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * distance, 1.2 + (i % 3) * 0.8, math.sin(angle) * distance),
			Size = Vector3.new(0.08, 0.08, 0.08),
			Transparency = 1,
		}):Play()
		Debris:AddItem(spark, 0.8)
	end
end

function CaptureService.new(options)
	local self = setmetatable({}, CaptureService)
	self.remote = options.remote
	self.wildFolder = options.wildFolder
	self.effectsFolder = options.effectsFolder
	self.canCarry = options.canCarry
	self.onCaptured = options.onCaptured
	self.notice = options.notice
	self.charges = {}
	self.projectiles = {}
	self.sessions = {}
	self.cooldowns = {}
	self.random = Random.new()
	self.connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		self:_step(dt)
	end)
	return self
end

function CaptureService:_finish(player, success, message)
	local session = self.sessions[player]
	if not session then
		return
	end
	self.sessions[player] = nil
	if session.tether then
		session.tether.from:Destroy()
		session.tether.to:Destroy()
	end
	if session.creature and session.creature.Parent then
		session.creature:SetAttribute("BusyUserId", nil)
	end
	if success and session.creature and session.creature.Parent then
		local position = session.creature.PrimaryPart.Position
		success = self.onCaptured(player, session.creature) == true
		if success then rewardBurst(self.effectsFolder, position, session.golden)
		else message = "Não foi possível guardar a criatura. Confira sua bolsa." end
	end
	self.remote:FireClient(player, "CaptureEnd", success, message, session.golden)
end

function CaptureService:_beginCapture(player, creature, lasso)
	if self.sessions[player] or not creature.Parent or creature.Parent ~= self.wildFolder then
		return false, "A criatura não está mais disponível."
	end
	if creature:GetAttribute("BusyUserId") then
		return false, "Esse Lumito já está sendo capturado."
	end
	if not self.canCarry(player) then
		return false, "Bolsa cheia: instale suas criaturas na base."
	end
	local root = playerRoot(player)
	if
		not root
		or not equippedLasso(player)
		or (root.Position - creature.PrimaryPart.Position).Magnitude > lasso.MaximumRange + 10
	then
		return false, "A criatura saiu do alcance."
	end
	creature:SetAttribute("BusyUserId", player.UserId)
	local golden = creature:GetAttribute("Golden") == true
	self.sessions[player] = {
		creature = creature,
		golden = golden,
		started = os.clock(),
		zone = 0.5,
		zoneVelocity = 0,
		target = 0.5,
		goal = 0.5,
		goalTimer = 0,
		progress = 0.16,
		maxDistance = lasso.MaximumRange + 10,
		streak = 0,
		tether = tether(player, creature),
		holding = false,
		sendTime = 0,
	}
	self.remote:FireClient(player, "CaptureStart", creature.Name, golden)
	return true
end

function CaptureService:_clearProjectile(player, ready)
	local projectile = self.projectiles[player]
	if projectile then
		Visuals.CleanupLine(projectile.line)
		projectile.visual:Destroy()
		self.projectiles[player] = nil
	end
	if ready then
		local cooldown = projectile and projectile.lasso.CooldownSeconds or 0
		self.cooldowns[player] = os.clock() + cooldown
		self.remote:FireClient(player, "ThrowReady", cooldown)
	end
end

function CaptureService:_returnProjectile(player, reason)
	local projectile = self.projectiles[player]
	if not projectile or projectile.returning then
		return
	end
	projectile.returning = true
	if projectile.line then
		projectile.line.beam.CurveSize0 = 1.2
	end
	self.remote:FireClient(player, "ThrowMiss", reason)
end

function CaptureService:_startCharge(player)
	local function deny(message)
		self.remote:FireClient(player, "ChargeDenied", message)
	end
	if self.charges[player] or self.projectiles[player] or self.sessions[player] then
		deny()
		return
	end
	if os.clock() < (self.cooldowns[player] or 0) then
		deny()
		return
	end
	if player:GetAttribute("Treinando") then
		deny("Encerre o treino antes de caçar.")
		return
	end
	if player:GetAttribute("ProfileReady") ~= true then deny("Aguarde seus dados carregarem."); return end
	local lasso, name = equippedLasso(player)
	if not playerRoot(player) or not lasso then
		deny()
		return
	end
	-- Bolsa cheia bloqueia somente a captura. Arremessar continua permitido.
	self.charges[player] = { started = os.clock(), lassoName = name }
	self.remote:FireClient(player, "ChargeReady")
end

function CaptureService:_throw(player, ray)
	local charge = self.charges[player]
	self.charges[player] = nil
	if not charge or self.projectiles[player] or self.sessions[player] then
		return
	end
	local root = playerRoot(player)
	local lasso, name = equippedLasso(player)
	if not root or not lasso or name ~= charge.lassoName or player:GetAttribute("Treinando") then
		self.remote:FireClient(player, "ThrowReady", 0)
		return
	end
	local allowedCameraDistance =
		math.min(Config.MaximumCameraDistance, (player.CameraMaxZoomDistance or 128) + Config.CameraTolerance)
	if
		typeof(ray) ~= "table"
		or not finiteVector(ray.origin)
		or not finiteVector(ray.direction)
		or (ray.origin - root.Position).Magnitude > allowedCameraDistance
		or ray.direction.Magnitude < 0.9
		or ray.direction.Magnitude > 1.1
	then
		-- Dados de rede inválidos são rejeitados; mirar no céu/chão não é inválido.
		self.remote:FireClient(player, "ThrowReady", 0)
		return
	end
	local power = math.clamp((os.clock() - charge.started) / lasso.ChargeSeconds, 0, 1)
	local params = Aim.Params({ player.Character, self.effectsFolder })
	local range = Aim.Range(lasso, power)
	local resolved = Aim.Resolve(Aim.Origin(player.Character), ray, range, params, Config.AimLimit)
	local blockers = Aim.Params({ player.Character, self.effectsFolder, self.wildFolder })
	local visual = Visuals.Loop(self.effectsFolder)
	visual:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(resolved.origin, resolved.origin + resolved.direction))
	self.projectiles[player] = {
		visual = visual,
		line = Visuals.Line(player.Character, visual.PrimaryPart),
		position = resolved.origin,
		startPosition = resolved.origin,
		direction = resolved.direction,
		-- O ponto visto ao lançar define a direção, não um limite congelado no alvo.
		-- Obstáculos e criaturas são consultados novamente durante todo o voo.
		distance = range,
		travel = 0,
		lasso = lasso,
		params = blockers,
		creatures = Collision.Snapshot(self.wildFolder),
	}
	self.remote:FireClient(player, "ThrowLaunched", power)
end

function CaptureService:HandleRemote(player, action, value)
	if action == "ChargeStart" then
		self:_startCharge(player)
	elseif action == "ChargeCancel" then
		self.charges[player] = nil
	elseif action == "Throw" then
		self:_throw(player, value)
	elseif action == "Hold" and typeof(value) == "boolean" then
		local session = self.sessions[player]
		if session then
			session.holding = value
		end
	end
end

function CaptureService:_stepProjectile(player, projectile, dt)
	local root = playerRoot(player)
	if not root or not equippedLasso(player) then
		self:_clearProjectile(player, true)
		return
	end
	if projectile.returning then
		local destination = Aim.Origin(player.Character)
		local delta = destination - projectile.position
		if delta.Magnitude < 1 then
			self:_clearProjectile(player, true)
			return
		end
		projectile.position += delta.Unit * math.min(delta.Magnitude, projectile.lasso.ReturnSpeed * dt)
		projectile.visual:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(projectile.position, projectile.position + projectile.direction))
		return
	end
	projectile.travel = math.min(projectile.distance, projectile.travel + projectile.lasso.ProjectileSpeed * dt)
	local nextPosition = projectile.startPosition + projectile.direction * projectile.travel
	local movement = nextPosition - projectile.position
	local hit = movement.Magnitude > 0 and workspace:Spherecast(
		projectile.position,
		Config.LoopRadius,
		movement,
		projectile.params
	) or nil
	local current = Collision.Snapshot(self.wildFolder)
	local blockerT = hit and hit.Distance / movement.Magnitude or nil
	local creature, contactT = Collision.Find(projectile.position, nextPosition, projectile.creatures,
		current, Config.LoopRadius, blockerT, projectile.params)
	projectile.creatures = current
	-- Spherecast.Position é a superfície atingida, não o centro do laço.
	projectile.position = projectile.position:Lerp(nextPosition, contactT or blockerT or 1)
	projectile.visual:PivotTo(
		CFrame.lookAt(projectile.position, projectile.position + projectile.direction)
			* CFrame.Angles(0, 0, projectile.travel * 0.14)
	)
	if hit or creature then
		Visuals.Burst(
			self.effectsFolder,
			projectile.position,
			creature and Color3.fromRGB(255, 221, 60) or Color3.fromRGB(100, 225, 255),
			creature and 12 or 5
		)
		if creature then
			local captured, reason = self:_beginCapture(player, creature, projectile.lasso)
			if captured then
				self:_clearProjectile(player, false)
			else
				self:_returnProjectile(player, reason)
			end
		else
			self:_returnProjectile(player)
		end
	elseif projectile.travel >= projectile.distance then
		self:_returnProjectile(player)
	end
end

function CaptureService:_stepSession(player, session, dt)
	local creature = session.creature
	local root = playerRoot(player)
	if
		not root
		or not creature.Parent
		or not equippedLasso(player)
		or (root.Position - creature.PrimaryPart.Position).Magnitude > session.maxDistance
	then
		self:_finish(player, false, nil)
		return
	end
	local elapsed = os.clock() - session.started
	if elapsed > Config.CaptureTimeLimit then
		self:_finish(player, false, "O Lumito escapou. Aproveite o cansaço para tentar de novo!")
		return
	end
	session.goalTimer -= dt
	if session.goalTimer <= 0 then
		session.goal = self.random:NextNumber(0.18, 0.82)
		session.goalTimer = self.random:NextNumber(session.golden and 0.5 or 0.65, session.golden and 0.85 or 1.05)
	end
	local difficulty = creature:GetAttribute("Difficulty") or 1
	local potion = (session.potionUntil or 0) > os.clock()
	local targetSpeed = 2.15 * difficulty * (potion and Gameplay.Items.Pocao.Slow or 1)
	session.target += (session.goal - session.target) * math.min(1, dt * targetSpeed)
	local desiredVelocity = session.holding and Config.ZoneMaxSpeed or -Config.ZoneMaxSpeed * 0.86
	session.zoneVelocity += (desiredVelocity - session.zoneVelocity) * math.min(1, dt * Config.ZoneFriction)
	session.zone = math.clamp(session.zone + session.zoneVelocity * dt, 0.06, 0.94)
	if session.zone == 0.06 or session.zone == 0.94 then
		session.zoneVelocity = 0
	end
	local strength = math.max(0, player:GetAttribute("Forca") or 0)
	local radius = Config.ZoneRadius + Config.StrengthRadiusBonus * strength / (strength + Config.StrengthHalfBonus)
	local overlap = math.abs(session.target - session.zone) <= radius
	if session.tether then
		session.tether.beam.Width0 = overlap and 0.23 or 0.16
		session.tether.beam.Width1 = session.tether.beam.Width0
	end
	local gain = Config.NormalGain / difficulty
	session.streak = math.clamp(session.streak + (overlap and 1 or -2) * dt, 0, 1.5)
	session.progress =
		math.clamp(session.progress + (overlap and gain * (1 + session.streak * 0.35) or -Config.MissDecay) * dt, 0, 1)
	session.sendTime += dt
	if session.sendTime >= Config.StateInterval then
		session.sendTime = 0
		self.remote:FireClient(player, "CaptureState", {
			target = session.target,
			zone = session.zone,
			radius = radius,
			progress = session.progress,
			overlap = overlap,
			streak = session.streak,
			timeLeft = Config.CaptureTimeLimit - elapsed,
			potion = potion,
		})
	end
	if session.progress >= 1 then
		self:_finish(player, true, "Lumito capturado!")
	end
end

function CaptureService:_step(dt)
	dt = math.min(dt, 0.08)
	for player, charge in pairs(self.charges) do
		if
			not playerRoot(player)
			or not equippedLasso(player)
			or os.clock() - charge.started > Config.MaximumChargeSeconds
		then
			self.charges[player] = nil
			self.remote:FireClient(player, "ChargeDenied")
		end
	end
	for player, projectile in pairs(self.projectiles) do
		self:_stepProjectile(player, projectile, dt)
	end
	for player, session in pairs(self.sessions) do
		self:_stepSession(player, session, dt)
	end
end

function CaptureService:PlayerRemoving(player)
	self.charges[player] = nil
	self.cooldowns[player] = nil
	local projectile = self.projectiles[player]
	if projectile then
		self:_clearProjectile(player, false)
	end
	local session = self.sessions[player]
	if session and session.tether then
		session.tether.from:Destroy()
		session.tether.to:Destroy()
	end
	if session and session.creature.Parent then
		session.creature:SetAttribute("BusyUserId", nil)
	end
	self.sessions[player] = nil
end

return CaptureService

-- Ciclo de vida das criaturas selvagens. Novas espécies escolhem perfil/comportamento.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Profiles = require(script.Parent.CreatureProfiles)
local Behaviors = { Lumito = require(script.Parent.LumitoBehavior) }
local Service = {}
Service.__index = Service

function Service.new(options)
	local self = setmetatable({ agents = {}, actors = {}, clock = 0, actorClock = 0 }, Service)
	self.ground = options.ground
	self.wildFolder = options.wildFolder
	self.effectsFolder = options.effectsFolder
	self.connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		self.clock += dt
		if self.clock < 0.05 then return end
		local step = math.min(self.clock, 0.1)
		self.clock = 0
		self.actorClock -= step
		if self.actorClock <= 0 then
			self.actorClock = 0.2
			table.clear(self.actors)
			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				local character = player.Character
				local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if root and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
					table.insert(self.actors, { character = character, root = root, humanoid = humanoid })
				end
			end
		end
		for model, agent in pairs(self.agents) do
			if model.Parent ~= self.wildFolder or not model.PrimaryPart then
				self.agents[model] = nil
			else
				agent:Step(step)
			end
		end
	end)
	return self
end

function Service:Add(model, species)
	local profile = assert(Profiles[species], "Espécie sem perfil: " .. species)
	local behavior = assert(Behaviors[profile.Behavior], "Comportamento não registrado")
	model:SetAttribute("Species", species)
	self.agents[model] = behavior.new(model, profile, self)
end

function Service:Destroy()
	self.connection:Disconnect()
	table.clear(self.agents)
	table.clear(self.actors)
end

return Service

-- Passeio -> visão -> pânico por tempo limitado -> cansaço -> passeio.
-- Movimento cinemático: os modelos de peças ancoradas não dependem de Humanoid/física.
local Behavior = {}
local Gameplay = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.HACShared.GameplayConfig)
Behavior.__index = Behavior
local ANGLES = { 0, 35, -35, 70, -70, 110, -110, 180 }
local function flat(v) return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z) end
local function unit(v, fallback)
	v = flat(v)
	return v.Magnitude > 0.001 and v.Unit or fallback
end

function Behavior.new(model, profile, service)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Behavior)
	self.model, self.profile, self.service = model, profile, service
	self.random = Random.new()
	self.scale = model:GetAttribute("CreatureScale") or 1
	self.radius = profile.BodyRadius * self.scale
	self.height = profile.RootHeight * self.scale
	self.bodySize = Vector3.new(self.radius * 2, 2.8 * self.scale, self.radius * 2)
	self.position = model.PrimaryPart.Position
	self.home = self.position
	self.facing = CFrame.Angles(0, self.random:NextNumber(-math.pi, math.pi), 0)
	self.direction = self.facing.LookVector
	self.moveDirection = Vector3.zero
	self.thinkIn, self.phase = self.random:NextNumber(0, profile.ThinkInterval), 0
	self.pause, self.walkTime = 0, 0
	self.walkFactor = 1
	self.stateTime = 0
	self.feet = {}
	for _, part in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name == "Pe" then
			table.insert(self.feet, { part = part, rest = model:GetPivot():ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame) })
		end
	end
	self.cast = RaycastParams.new()
	self.cast.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	self.cast.RespectCanCollide = true
	self.overlap = OverlapParams.new()
	self.overlap.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	self.overlap.RespectCanCollide = true
	self.overlap.MaxParts = 1
	self.vision = RaycastParams.new()
	self.vision.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	self.vision.FilterDescendantsInstances = { service.wildFolder, service.effectsFolder }
	self:_refreshFilters()
	local grounded = self:_groundAt(self.position)
	if grounded then self.position, self.home = grounded, grounded end
	self:_setState("Wandering")
	model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(self.position) * self.facing)
	return self
end

function Behavior:_setState(state)
	if self.state == state then return end
	self.state, self.stateTime, self.thinkIn = state, 0, 0
	self.moveDirection = Vector3.zero
	if state == "Wandering" then
		self.goal = nil
		self:_pauseWalk()
	end
	self.model:SetAttribute("BehaviorState", state)
	-- Sinal curto no nome já existente; nenhuma nova janela/tutorial.
	local label = self.model.PrimaryPart:FindFirstChild("Identificacao")
	local text = label and label:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
	if text then
		text.Text = self.model.Name .. (state == "Panicking" and "  !" or state == "Tired" and "  …" or "")
	end
end

function Behavior:_refreshFilters()
	local excluded = { self.service.wildFolder, self.service.effectsFolder }
	for _, actor in ipairs(self.service.actors) do table.insert(excluded, actor.character) end
	self.cast.FilterDescendantsInstances = excluded
	self.overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances = excluded
end

function Behavior:_inside(position)
	local ground = self.service.ground
	local localPoint = ground.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
	local margin = self.radius + self.profile.EdgeMargin
	return math.abs(localPoint.X) < ground.Size.X / 2 - margin
		and math.abs(localPoint.Z) < ground.Size.Z / 2 - margin
end

function Behavior:_groundAt(position)
	if not self:_inside(position) then return nil end
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), Vector3.new(0, -9, 0), self.cast)
	if not hit or hit.Normal.Y < 0.85 then return nil end
	local y = hit.Position.Y + self.height
	if math.abs(y - self.position.Y) > self.profile.MaxStepHeight then return nil end
	return Vector3.new(position.X, y, position.Z)
end

function Behavior:_separated(position)
	-- Não empurrar personagens nem sobrepor outros Lumitos. Permite sair de uma
	-- sobreposição provocada pelo próprio jogador, em vez de prender a criatura.
	local function clear(otherPosition, gap)
		if math.abs(position.Y - otherPosition.Y) > 4 then return true end
		local nextDistance = flat(position - otherPosition).Magnitude
		local currentDistance = flat(self.position - otherPosition).Magnitude
		local movement = flat(position - self.position)
		if currentDistance < gap then
			return nextDistance > currentDistance + 0.01 and movement:Dot(flat(self.position - otherPosition)) >= 0
		end
		local lengthSquared = movement:Dot(movement)
		local t = lengthSquared > 0 and math.clamp(flat(otherPosition - self.position):Dot(movement) / lengthSquared, 0, 1) or 0
		return flat(self.position + movement * t - otherPosition).Magnitude >= gap
	end
	for model, other in pairs(self.service.agents) do
		if other ~= self and model.Parent == self.service.wildFolder then
			if not clear(other.position, self.radius + other.radius) then return false end
		end
	end
	for _, actor in ipairs(self.service.actors) do
		if actor.root.Parent and not clear(actor.root.Position, self.radius + 1.1) then return false end
	end
	return true
end

function Behavior:_canStep(direction, distance)
	local destination = self:_groundAt(self.position + direction * distance)
	if not destination or not self:_separated(destination) then return nil end
	local offset = Vector3.new(0, 0.15, 0)
	-- Varredura do volume, mais sobreposição no destino: Blockcast sozinho não
	-- detecta obstáculos que já intersectam a forma inicial.
	if workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(self.position + offset), self.bodySize, destination - self.position, self.cast) then
		return nil
	end
	if #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(destination + offset), self.bodySize, self.overlap) > 0 then
		return nil
	end
	return destination
end

function Behavior:_visibleThreat()
	local closest, best = nil, self.profile.ViewDistance
	local eye = self.position + Vector3.new(0, 0.45 * self.scale, 0)
	local forward = self.facing.LookVector
	local cosine = math.cos(math.rad(self.profile.ViewAngle / 2))
	for _, actor in ipairs(self.service.actors) do
		if actor.root.Parent and actor.humanoid.Health > 0 then
			local delta = actor.root.Position - eye
			local distance = delta.Magnitude
			if distance < best and forward:Dot(unit(delta, forward)) >= cosine then
				local hit = workspace:Raycast(eye, delta, self.vision)
				if not hit or hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(actor.character) then
					closest, best = actor.root.Position, distance
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return closest
end

function Behavior:_wanderGoal()
	local angle = self.random:NextNumber(-math.pi, math.pi)
	local distance = self.random:NextNumber(4, self.profile.WanderRadius)
	local goal = self.home + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle)) * distance
	-- Alvos de passeio sempre ficam dentro da ilha, inclusive spawns próximos da borda.
	local ground = self.service.ground
	local p = ground.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(goal)
	local margin = self.radius + self.profile.EdgeMargin + 1
	p = Vector3.new(math.clamp(p.X, -ground.Size.X / 2 + margin, ground.Size.X / 2 - margin), p.Y,
		math.clamp(p.Z, -ground.Size.Z / 2 + margin, ground.Size.Z / 2 - margin))
	self.goal = ground.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(p)
end

function Behavior:_pauseWalk()
	local p = self.profile
	local long = self.random:NextNumber() < p.LongPauseChance
	self.pause = self.random:NextNumber(long and p.LongPauseMin or p.PauseMin, long and p.LongPauseMax or p.PauseMax)
	self.walkTime = 0
	self.moveDirection = Vector3.zero
end

function Behavior:_resumeWalk()
	if not self.goal or flat(self.goal - self.position).Magnitude < 1.5
		or self.random:NextNumber() >= self.profile.ResumeSameGoalChance then
		self:_wanderGoal()
	end
	self.walkTime = self.random:NextNumber(self.profile.WalkBurstMin, self.profile.WalkBurstMax)
	self.walkFactor = self.random:NextNumber(self.profile.WalkSpeedMinFactor, self.profile.WalkSpeedMaxFactor)
end

function Behavior:_chooseDirection(preferred, speed)
	local bestDirection, bestScore = Vector3.zero, -math.huge
	local lookAhead = math.max(2, speed * 0.35)
	for _, degrees in ipairs(ANGLES) do
		local direction = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(degrees), 0):VectorToWorldSpace(preferred)
		if self:_canStep(direction, lookAhead) then
			local score = direction:Dot(preferred) * 2 + direction:Dot(self.direction) * 0.45
			if score > bestScore then bestDirection, bestScore = direction, score end
		end
	end
	return bestDirection
end

function Behavior:_think()
	self:_refreshFilters()
	local threat = self:_visibleThreat()
	if threat then
		self.lastThreat = threat
		if self.state == "Wandering" then self:_setState("Panicking") end
	end
	local preferred
	if self.state == "Wandering" then
		local attractor = self.service.attractor and self.service.attractor(self.position, self.vision)
		if attractor then
			self.goal = Vector3.new(attractor.X, self.position.Y, attractor.Z)
			self.pause, self.walkTime = 0, math.max(self.walkTime, 1)
		end
		if self.pause > 0 then self.moveDirection = Vector3.zero; return end
		if self.walkTime <= 0 then self:_resumeWalk() end
		if flat(self.goal - self.position).Magnitude < 1.5 then
			self:_pauseWalk()
			return
		end
		preferred = unit(self.goal - self.position, self.direction)
	else
		-- Ao perder visão, foge da última posição vista; não acompanha através de paredes.
		preferred = self.lastThreat and unit(self.position - self.lastThreat, self.direction) or self.direction
	end
	self.moveDirection = self:_chooseDirection(preferred, self:_speed())
	if self.moveDirection.Magnitude < 0.01 and self.state == "Wandering" then
		self.goal = nil
		self:_pauseWalk()
	end
end

function Behavior:_speed()
	local speed = self.state == "Panicking" and self.profile.PanicSpeed
		or self.state == "Tired" and self.profile.TiredSpeed or self.profile.WalkSpeed * self.walkFactor
	return speed * ((self.model:GetAttribute("SlowedUntil") or 0) > os.clock() and Gameplay.Items.Armadilha.Slow or 1)
end

function Behavior:Step(dt)
	if self.model:GetAttribute("BusyUserId") ~= nil then
		if self.state ~= "Capturing" then
			self:_setState("Capturing")
			self:_pose(false)
		end
		return -- A disputa existente mantém o alvo imóvel e não consome o timer de fuga.
	elseif self.state == "Capturing" then
		self:_setState("Tired") -- Escapou do laço: oferece janela lenta, sem sprint imediato.
	end
	self.stateTime += dt
	if self.state == "Wandering" then
		if self.pause > 0 then
			self.pause = math.max(0, self.pause - dt)
		elseif self.walkTime > 0 then
			self.walkTime -= dt
			if self.walkTime <= 0 then self:_pauseWalk() end
		end
	end
	if self.state == "Panicking" and self.stateTime >= self.profile.PanicSeconds then
		self:_setState("Tired")
	elseif self.state == "Tired" and self.stateTime >= self.profile.RecoverySeconds then
		self.lastThreat, self.goal = nil, nil
		self:_setState("Wandering")
	end
	self.thinkIn -= dt
	if self.thinkIn <= 0 then
		self:_think()
		self.thinkIn = self.profile.ThinkInterval
	end
	local moving = self.moveDirection.Magnitude > 0.01
	if moving then
		local destination = self:_canStep(self.moveDirection, self:_speed() * dt)
		if destination then
			self.position = destination
			self.direction = self.moveDirection
			local facing = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, self.direction)
			self.facing = self.facing:Lerp(facing, 1 - math.exp(-dt * 12))
		else
			moving = false
			self.moveDirection = Vector3.zero
			self.thinkIn = 0
		end
	end
	self.phase += dt * (self.state == "Panicking" and 18 or 7)
	self:_pose(moving)
end

function Behavior:_pose(moving)
	local slow = (self.model:GetAttribute("SlowedUntil") or 0) > os.clock()
	if self.wasSlowed ~= slow then
		self.wasSlowed = slow
		local label = self.model.PrimaryPart:FindFirstChild("Identificacao")
		local text = label and label:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
		if text then text.Text = self.model.Name .. (slow and " • LENTO" or self.state == "Panicking" and " !" or self.state == "Tired" and " …" or "") end
	end
	local bounce = moving and math.abs(math.sin(self.phase)) * (self.state == "Panicking" and 0.13 or 0.045) or 0
	local roll = moving and math.sin(self.phase) * (self.state == "Panicking" and 0.07 or 0.025) or 0
	local pose = CFrame.new(self.position + Vector3.new(0, bounce, 0)) * self.facing * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, roll)
	self.model:PivotTo(pose)
	for i, foot in ipairs(self.feet) do
		local step = moving and math.sin(self.phase + (i - 1) * math.pi) or 0
		foot.part.CFrame = pose * foot.rest * CFrame.new(0, math.max(0, step) * 0.18 * self.scale, step * 0.24 * self.scale)
	end
end

return Behavior

-- Contato contínuo com o corpo, independente de pés/olhos animados.
-- O servidor considera o deslocamento relativo do projétil e da criatura.
local Collision = {}

function Collision.Segment(startPoint, endPoint, previousCenter, center, rotation, radii)
	local a = rotation:VectorToObjectSpace(startPoint - previousCenter) / radii
	local b = rotation:VectorToObjectSpace(endPoint - center) / radii
	local delta = b - a
	local c = a:Dot(a) - 1
	if c <= 0 then return 0 end -- Já está em contato no início do passo.
	local quadratic = delta:Dot(delta)
	if quadratic < 1e-10 then return nil end
	local linear = 2 * a:Dot(delta)
	local discriminant = linear * linear - 4 * quadratic * c
	if discriminant < 0 then return nil end
	local t = (-linear - math.sqrt(discriminant)) / (2 * quadratic)
	return t >= 0 and t <= 1 and t or nil
end

function Collision.Snapshot(folder)
	local result = {}
	for _, model in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		if model:IsA("Model") and model.PrimaryPart then

				result[model] = { center = body.Position, rotation = body.CFrame.Rotation, size = body.Size }
			end
		end
	end
	return result
end

function Collision.Find(startPoint, endPoint, previous, current, radius, blockerT, params)
	local closest, earliest = nil, blockerT or math.huge
	for model, body in pairs(current) do
		local old = previous[model] or body
		local radii = body.size / 2 + Vector3.one * radius
		local t = Collision.Segment(startPoint, endPoint, old.center, body.center, body.rotation, radii)
		if t and t < earliest then
			local contact = startPoint:Lerp(endPoint, t)
			-- O volume de contato não permite capturar através de uma parede.
			local visible = not workspace:Raycast(contact, body.center - contact, params)
			if visible then closest, earliest = model, t end
		end
	end
	return closest, closest and earliest or nil
end

function Data.Validate(p)
	assert(type(p) == "table" and p.schemaVersion == C.SchemaVersion, "Versão de perfil incompatível")
	for _, key in ipairs({"gold", "xp", "strength", "revision"}) do
		assert(type(p[key]) == "number" and p[key] >= 0 and p[key] < math.huge, "Valor inválido: " .. key)
	end
	for _, key in ipairs({"creatures", "discoveries", "upgrades", "items", "owned", "shop"}) do
		assert(type(p[key]) == "table", "Campo inválido: " .. key)
	end
	for key, def in pairs(C.Upgrades) do
		local level = p.upgrades[key] or 0
		assert(type(level) == "number" and level % 1 == 0 and level >= 0 and level < #def.Values, "Upgrade inválido")
	end
	local slots = {}
	for id, item in pairs(p.creatures) do
		assert(type(id) == "string" and item.id == id and C.Species[item.species], "Criatura inválida")
		assert(table.find(C.Rarities, item.rarity) and type(item.size) == "number" and item.size >= 0.5 and item.size <= 2, "Variação inválida")
		assert(type(item.mutations) == "table", "Mutações inválidas")
		for _, mutation in ipairs(item.mutations) do assert(C.Mutations[mutation], "Mutação desconhecida") end
		assert(item.location == "bag" or item.location == "base", "Localização inválida")
		if item.location == "base" then
			assert(type(item.slot) == "number" and item.slot % 1 == 0 and item.slot >= 1 and item.slot <= C.Stat(p, "Base") and not slots[item.slot], "Slot inválido")
			slots[item.slot] = true
		end
	end
	for key, value in pairs(p.items) do
		assert(C.Items[key] and type(value) == "number" and value % 1 == 0 and value >= 0 and value <= C.ItemCapacity(key), "Itens inválidos")
	end
	assert(type(p.shop.rotation) == "string" and type(p.shop.bought) == "table", "Cota inválida")
	return p
end
function Data.Count(p, location)
	local count = 0
	for _, item in pairs(p.creatures) do if item.location == location then count += 1 end end
	return count
end
function Data.FreeSlot(p)
	local used = {}
	for _, item in pairs(p.creatures) do if item.location == "base" then used[item.slot] = true end end
	for slot = 1, C.Stat(p, "Base") do if not used[slot] then return slot end end
end
function Data.Capture(p, creature)
	if p.creatures[creature.id] or Data.Count(p, "bag") >= C.Stat(p, "Bolsa") then return false, "Bolsa cheia." end
	local item = Data.Copy(creature)
	item.location, item.slot = "bag", nil
	p.creatures[item.id] = item
	local first = not p.discoveries[item.species]
	p.discoveries[item.species] = true
	return true, first and "Nova descoberta!" or "Criatura capturada!"
end
function Data.Action(p, action, args, rotation)
	local item = type(args.id) == "string" and p.creatures[args.id]
	if action == "Install" then
		local slot = Data.FreeSlot(p)
		if not item or item.location ~= "bag" then return false, "Escolha uma criatura da bolsa." end
		if not slot then return false, "Base cheia: use Trocar." end
		item.location, item.slot = "base", slot
	elseif action == "Sell" then
		if not item then return false, "Essa criatura não está disponível." end
		p.gold += C.Value(item, "Sale")
		p.creatures[item.id] = nil
	elseif action == "Swap" then
		local other = type(args.other) == "string" and p.creatures[args.other]
		if not item or not other or item.location ~= "bag" or other.location ~= "base" then return false, "Selecione uma criatura da bolsa e outra da base." end
		item.location, item.slot = "base", other.slot
		other.location, other.slot = "bag", nil
	elseif action == "Upgrade" then
		local def = C.Upgrades[args.id]
		if not def then return false, "Melhoria inválida." end
		local level = p.upgrades[args.id] or 0
		local cost = def.Costs[level + 1]
		if not cost then return false, "Nível máximo desta versão." end
		if p.gold < cost then return false, "Ouro insuficiente." end
		p.gold -= cost
		p.upgrades[args.id] = level + 1
	elseif action == "Buy" then
		if args.rotation ~= rotation.id then return false, "O estoque mudou. Confira a nova oferta." end
		local offer, def = rotation.offers[args.id], C.Items[args.id]
		if not offer or not def then return false, "Item fora desta rotação." end
		if def.Permanent and p.owned[args.id] then return false, "Você já possui este equipamento." end
		local bought = C.Bought(p, rotation, args.id)
		if offer.stock <= 0 then return false, "Sem estoque nesta reposição." end
		if bought >= offer.stock then return false, "Sua cota desta rotação acabou." end
		if not def.Permanent and (p.items[args.id] or 0) >= C.ItemCapacity(args.id) then return false, "Limite de ferramentas atingido." end
		if p.gold < offer.price then return false, "Ouro insuficiente." end
		if p.shop.rotation ~= rotation.id then
			p.shop = {rotation = rotation.id, bought = C.SameShopWindow(p.shop.rotation, rotation.id) and p.shop.bought or {}}
		end
		p.gold -= offer.price
		p.shop.bought[args.id] = bought + 1
		if def.Permanent then p.owned[args.id] = true else p.items[args.id] = (p.items[args.id] or 0) + 1 end
	else return false, "Ação inválida." end
	local message = "Sell" == action and "Criatura vendida." or "Buy" == action and "Item recebido!" or "Coleção atualizada."
	if action == "Upgrade" then
		local def = C.Upgrades[args.id]
		message = def.Name .. " melhorado! " .. C.Stat(p,args.id) .. " " .. def.Unit
		if def.Group == "Treino" then message ..= " • +" .. C.TrainingGain(p) .. " força / " .. C.TrainingSeconds .. " s" end
	end
	return true, message
end

-- Nunca substituir uma falha de leitura por um perfil novo.
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Data = require(script.Parent.ProfileData)
local Service = {}
Service.__index = Service
local LEASE_SECONDS, FREEZE_MARGIN = 180, 45
function Service.new()
	local memory = RunService:IsStudio() and workspace:GetAttribute("HACStudioMemoryMode") == true
	return setmetatable({sessions = {}, memory = memory,
		store = not memory and DataStoreService:GetDataStore(RunService:IsStudio() and "HAC_Profiles_Studio_v1" or "HAC_Profiles_v1") or nil}, Service)
end
function Service:Load(player)
	local token = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	local result, reason
	for attempt = 1, 3 do
		local ok, value = pcall(function()
			if self.memory then return {data = Data.New(), lease = {token = token, expires = os.time() + LEASE_SECONDS}} end
			return self.store:UpdateAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId, function(old)
				if old and old.lease and old.lease.token ~= token and old.lease.expires > os.time() then return nil end
				local data = old and Data.Validate(old.data) or Data.New()
				return {data = data, lease = {token = token, expires = os.time() + LEASE_SECONDS}}
			end)
		end)
		if ok and value and value.lease and value.lease.token == token then result = value; break end
		reason = ok and "Perfil ainda aberto em outra sessão." or tostring(value)
		if attempt < 3 then task.wait(attempt * 2) end
	end
	if not result then warn("[HAC Perfil] " .. player.UserId .. ": " .. tostring(reason)); return nil end
	self.sessions[player] = {data = result.data, token = token, expires = result.lease.expires, saving = false, closing = false}
	return result.data
end
function Service:Get(player)
	local session = self.sessions[player]
	if session and not session.closing and (self.memory or os.time() < session.expires - FREEZE_MARGIN) then return session.data end
end
function Service:Save(player, release)
	local session = self.sessions[player]
	if not session then return true end
	if release then session.closing = true end
	local deadline = os.clock() + 20
	while session.saving and os.clock() < deadline do task.wait(0.1) end
	if session.saving then return false end
	-- Outro encerramento pode ter concluído durante a espera.
	if self.sessions[player] ~= session then return true end
	session.saving = true
	local snapshot = Data.Copy(session.data)
	local saved = false
	for attempt = 1, 3 do
		local ok, value = pcall(function()
			if self.memory then return {data = snapshot, lease = {token = session.token, expires = os.time() + LEASE_SECONDS}} end
			return self.store:UpdateAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId, function(old)
				if not old or not old.lease or old.lease.token ~= session.token then return nil end
				return {data = snapshot, lease = not release and {token = session.token, expires = os.time() + LEASE_SECONDS} or nil}
			end)
		end)
		if ok and value then
			saved = true
			if not release then session.expires = value.lease.expires end
			break
		elseif ok then
			session.closing = true
			warn("[HAC Perfil] Sessão perdeu a posse do perfil: " .. player.UserId)
			break
		else
			warn("[HAC Perfil] Falha de salvamento: " .. tostring(value))
		end
		if attempt < 3 then task.wait(attempt) end
	end
	session.saving = false
	if release and saved then self.sessions[player] = nil end
	return saved
end
function Service:Change(player, callback, passive)
	local profile = self:Get(player)
	if not profile then return false, "Progresso indisponível. Aguarde o salvamento." end
	-- Copy-on-write mantém transações indivisíveis e sem efeitos parciais em falhas.
	local nextProfile = Data.Copy(profile)
	local ok, accepted, message = pcall(callback, nextProfile)
	if not ok then warn("[HAC Transação] " .. tostring(accepted)); return false, "Não foi possível concluir a ação." end
	if not accepted then return false, message end
	-- A revisão protege ações sobre a coleção; renda/treino não invalidam cliques.
	-- O snapshot completo, inclusive ganhos passivos, continua sendo salvo.
	nextProfile.revision = profile.revision + (passive and 0 or 1)
	self.sessions[player].data = nextProfile
	return true, message
end
return Service

function World:RenderBase(base, profile)
	local folder = base.CriaturasInstaladas
	local byId = {}
	for _, model in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do byId[model:GetAttribute("CreatureId") or ""] = model end
	for id, item in pairs(profile.creatures) do
		if item.location == "base" then
			local marker = base:FindFirstChild("Lugar" .. item.slot)
			if marker then
				local model = byId[id]
				local position = marker.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.68 * item.size * 0.72, 0)
				if not model then model = Factory.Build(folder, position, item, true) else model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position)) end
				byId[id] = nil
			end
		end
	end
	for _, model in pairs(byId) do model:Destroy() end
	for _, marker in ipairs(base:GetChildren()) do
		local slot = tonumber(marker.Name:match("^Lugar(%d+)$"))
		if slot and marker:IsA("BasePart") then marker.Transparency = slot <= C.Stat(profile, "Base") and 0.15 or 1 end
	end
	local dummy = self.dummies[base]
	if dummy then
		dummy.Alvo.Color = Color3.fromRGB(234, 183, 111):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(255, 219, 62), (profile.upgrades.Treino or 0) / math.max(1,#C.Upgrades.Treino.Values-1))
		base.Esteira.Treinar.ObjectText = "Manequim " .. ((profile.upgrades.Treino or 0) + 1) .. " • +" .. C.TrainingGain(profile) .. " força / " .. C.TrainingSeconds .. " s"
	end
end
function World:StopTraining(player, speed)
	local state = self.exercise[player]
	if not state then return end
	self.exercise[player] = nil
	Visuals.CleanupLine(state.line)
	state.loop:Destroy()
	if state.root.Parent then state.root.Anchored = state.anchored end
	if state.humanoid.Parent then
		state.humanoid.WalkSpeed = speed or state.speed
		state.humanoid.AutoRotate = state.autoRotate
	end
end
function World:StartTraining(player, base, effects)
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local dummy = self.dummies[base]
	if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not dummy then return false end
	local state = {root = root, humanoid = humanoid, anchored = root.Anchored, autoRotate = humanoid.AutoRotate, speed = humanoid.WalkSpeed, target = dummy.Alvo, started = os.clock()}
	root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(base.Esteira.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 1.7), dummy.Alvo.Position)
	root.Anchored, humanoid.WalkSpeed, humanoid.AutoRotate = true, 0, false
	state.loop = Visuals.Loop(effects)
	state.line = Visuals.Line(character, state.loop.PrimaryPart)
	self.exercise[player] = state
	return true
end
function World:AnimateTraining()
	for _, state in pairs(self.exercise) do
		if state.root.Parent and state.target.Parent then
			local phase = (os.clock() - state.started) % C.TrainingSeconds / C.TrainingSeconds
			local from = state.root.Position + Vector3.new(1, 0.4, 0)
			local t = phase < 0.65 and phase / 0.65 or (1 - phase) / 0.35
			local pos = from:Lerp(state.target.Position, t)
			state.loop:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + state.root.CFrame.LookVector))
		end
	end
end
return World

function HUD:OpenSheet(kind)

	if self.capturing then
		return
	end
	self.sheetKind = kind
	local scale = 1
	Audio.Play("Open")
	if self.sheetTween then
		self.sheetTween:Cancel()
	end
	self.SheetScale.Scale = scale * 0.92
	self.sheetTween = TweenService:Create(
		self.SheetScale,
		TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		{ Scale = scale }
	)
	self.sheetTween:Play()
	self.Shade.Visible = true
	self.Sheet.Visible = true
	self.BagContent.Visible = kind == "bag"
	self.DetailBody.Visible = kind ~= "bag"
	self.BagSkin:SetSelected(kind == "bag")
	if kind == "bag" then
		self.SheetIcon.Image = S.Icons.Bag
		self.SheetTitle.Text = "BOLSA"
		self.Sheet.ImageColor3 = S.UI.Cyan
	else
		local data = details[kind]
		if not data then
			self:CloseSheet()
			return
		end
		self.SheetTitle.Text = data[1]
		self.SheetIcon.Image = data[2]
		self.Sheet.ImageColor3 = data[3]
		self.DetailBody.Text = data[4]
	end
	self:UpdateStats()
end
function HUD:CloseSheet()

	self.Shade.Visible = false

	local baseCapacity = self.player:GetAttribute("BaseCapacity") or 3

		slot.caption.Text = i <= carried and "Ocupado" or "Livre"

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local Config = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").HACShared.CaptureConfig)

local Feedback = require(script.Parent.LassoFeedback)
local Aim = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.HACShared.LassoAim)

local Controller = {}
Controller.__index = Controller

local function isPointer(input)
	return input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
end

function Controller.new(player, remote, hud)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Controller)
	self.player = player
	self.remote = remote
	self.hud = hud
	self.equipped = false
	self.charging = false
	self.chargeInput = nil
	self.chargeMode = nil
	self.chargeStarted = 0
	self.capturing = false
	self.holding = false
	self.holdInput = nil
	self.lasso = nil
	self.feedback = Feedback.new(player)
	self.flying = false
	self.readyAt = 0

	local function attachCharacter(character)
		ContextActionService:UnbindAction("HACCaptureHold")
		self:_cancelCharge()
		self.capturing = false
		self.holding = false
		self.flying = false
		self.feedback:Hide()
		local function update()
			local tool = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
			self.lasso = tool and Config.Lassos[tool.Name] or nil
			self.equipped = self.lasso ~= nil
			self.hud:SetEquipped(self.equipped)
			self.hud.Reticle.Visible = self.equipped and UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not self.capturing
			if not self.equipped then
				self:_cancelCharge()
			end
		end
		character.ChildAdded:Connect(update)
		character.ChildRemoved:Connect(update)
		update()
	end
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(attachCharacter)
	if player.Character then
		attachCharacter(player.Character)
	end

	hud.ThrowButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if isPointer(input) then
			self:_startCharge("button", input)
		end
	end)
	hud.ThrowButton.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input == self.chargeInput then
			self:_releaseCharge()
		end
	end)
	hud.HoldButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if isPointer(input) and self.capturing then
			self.holdInput = input
			self:_setHolding(true)
		end
	end)
	hud.HoldButton.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input == self.holdInput then
			self:_setHolding(false)
			self.holdInput = nil
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
		if self.capturing then
			if not processed and (input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA) then
				self:_setHolding(true)
			end
			return
		end
		if processed then
			return
		end
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			self:_startCharge("mouse", input)
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR2 then
			self:_startCharge("center", input)
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if self.capturing then
			if
				input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space
				or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA
				or input == self.holdInput
			then
				self:_setHolding(false)
				self.holdInput = nil
			end
			return
		end
		if input == self.chargeInput then
			self:_releaseCharge()
		end
	end)
	self.renderConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if self.hud.sheetKind and self.charging then self:_cancelCharge() end
		if not self.equipped or self.capturing or self.flying or self.hud.sheetKind or self.player:GetAttribute("Treinando") or self.hud.Collection and self.hud.Collection.selected then
			self.feedback:Hide(self.flying)
			return
		end
		local power = self.charging and math.clamp((os.clock() - self.chargeStarted) / self.lasso.ChargeSeconds, 0, 1)
			or 1
		local inputType = UserInputService:GetLastInputType()
		local center = self.charging and self.chargeMode ~= "mouse"
			or not self.charging and (UserInputService.TouchEnabled or inputType.Name:find("Gamepad") ~= nil)
		self.feedback:Update(self:_aimRay(center), self.lasso, power, self.charging)
		if self.charging then
			self.hud:SetCharging(power, Aim.Range(self.lasso, power), self.lasso.MaximumRange)
		end
	end)
	hud.Gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
		ContextActionService:UnbindAction("HACCaptureHold")
		self.renderConnection:Disconnect()
		self.feedback:Destroy()
	end)
	UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function()
		self:_cancelCharge()
		self:_setHolding(false)
		self.holdInput = nil
	end)

	return self
end

function Controller:_aimRay(center)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then
		return nil
	end
	local screenPoint
	if center then
		screenPoint = camera.ViewportSize / 2
	else
		-- GetMouseLocation e ViewportPointToRay usam as mesmas coordenadas.
		screenPoint = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
	end
	local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(screenPoint.X, screenPoint.Y)
	return { origin = ray.Origin, direction = ray.Direction }
end

function Controller:_startCharge(mode, input)
	if self.hud.Collection and self.hud.Collection.selected and not self.hud.sheetKind and not self.capturing and not self.flying and not self.player:GetAttribute("Treinando") then
		self.hud.Collection:Place(self:_aimRay(mode ~= "mouse"))
		return
	end
	if
		self.charging
		or self.capturing
		or self.flying
		or os.clock() < self.readyAt
		or not self.equipped
		or self.hud.sheetKind
		or self.player:GetAttribute("Treinando")
		or self.player:GetAttribute("ProfileReady") ~= true
	then
		return
	end
	self.charging = true
	self.chargeMode = mode
	self.chargeInput = input
	self.chargeStarted = os.clock()
	self.remote:FireServer("ChargeStart")
	self.hud:SetCharging(0)
end

function Controller:_releaseCharge()
	if not self.charging then
		return
	end
	local aim = self:_aimRay(self.chargeMode ~= "mouse")
	self.charging = false
	self.chargeInput = nil
	self.chargeMode = nil
	if aim then
		self.flying = true
		self.feedback:Hide(true)
		self.remote:FireServer("Throw", aim)
		Audio.StopCharge()
		Audio.Play("Throw")
		self.hud:ThrowLaunched()
	else
		self.remote:FireServer("ChargeCancel")
	end
end

function Controller:_cancelCharge()
	if not self.charging then
		return
	end
	self.charging = false
	self.chargeInput = nil
	self.chargeMode = nil
	self.remote:FireServer("ChargeCancel")
	self.hud:ResetThrow()
end

function Controller:_setHolding(value)
	if not self.capturing or self.holding == value then
		return
	end
	self.holding = value
	self.remote:FireServer("Hold", value)
	self.hud:SetHolding(value)
end

function Controller:HandleEvent(action, a, b, c)
	if action == "ChargeReady" then
		return
	elseif action == "ChargeDenied" then
		self.flying = false
		self.charging = false
		self.chargeInput = nil
		self.chargeMode = nil
		self.hud:ResetThrow()
		if a then
			self.hud:Notice(a)
		end
	elseif action == "ThrowReady" then
		self.flying = false
		self.readyAt = os.clock() + (a or 0)
		self.hud:ResetThrow()
	elseif action == "ThrowLaunched" then
		self.hud:ThrowLaunched()
	elseif action == "ThrowMiss" then
		Audio.Play("Return")
		self.hud:ResetThrow()
		if a then
			self.hud:Notice(a)
		end
	elseif action == "CaptureStart" then
		if self.hud.Collection then self.hud.Collection.selected = nil end
		self.flying = false
		self.feedback:Hide()
		self.charging = false
		self.chargeInput = nil
		self.capturing = true
		self.holding = false
		self.hud:StartCapture(a, b)
		ContextActionService:BindActionAtPriority("HACCaptureHold", function(_, state)
			self:_setHolding(state == Enum.UserInputState.Begin)
			return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
		end, false, 3000, Enum.KeyCode.Space, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA)
	elseif action == "CaptureState" then
		self.hud:CaptureState(a)
	elseif action == "CaptureEnd" then
		ContextActionService:UnbindAction("HACCaptureHold")
		self.flying = false
		self.capturing = false
		self.holding = false
		self.holdInput = nil
		self.hud:EndCapture(a, b)
		self.hud.Reticle.Visible = self.equipped and UserInputService.TouchEnabled
	elseif action == "Reward" then
		self.hud:Reward(a, b)
	elseif action == "Notice" then
		self.hud:Notice(a)
	end
end

return Controller

		if isBusy() then
			return
		end
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then

		end
		local equipped = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")

				if tool:IsA("Tool") and Config.Lassos[tool.Name] then
					humanoid:EquipTool(tool)
					return
				end
			end
		end
	end

	table.insert(
		self.connections,
		UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
			if not processed and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.One then

			end

		previous[kind] = StarterGui:GetCoreGuiEnabled(kind)
		StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(kind, false)

		for _, c in ipairs(self.connections) do

		or Color3.fromRGB(59, 245, 227)

		Visuals.Burst(self.Folder, resolved.endpoint, Color3.fromRGB(91, 255, 206), 4)

	self.Marker.Position = resolved.endpoint
	self.Marker.Transparency = charging and 0.15 or 1

			or character:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
			or character.HumanoidRootPart

local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
local Config = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.HACShared.AudioConfig)
local Audio = { templates = {}, voices = {}, last = {}, generation = 0 }

function Audio.Init()
	if Audio.root then return end
	local root = Instance.new("Folder")
	root.Name = "HACAudio"
	root.Parent = SoundService
	Audio.root = root
	local group = Instance.new("SoundGroup")
	group.Name = "HAC_Efeitos"
	group.Volume = Audio.muted and 0 or Config.MasterVolume
	group.Parent = root
	Audio.group = group
	for _, cue in pairs(Config.Cues) do
		if not Audio.templates[cue.id] then
			local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
			sound.Name = cue.id
			sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. cue.id
			sound.SoundGroup = group
			sound.Volume = 0
			sound.Parent = root
			Audio.templates[cue.id] = sound
		end
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		local list = {}
		for _, sound in pairs(Audio.templates) do table.insert(list, sound) end
		pcall(function()
			ContentProvider:PreloadAsync(list, function(id, status)
				if status ~= Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then
					warn("[HAC Audio] Asset indisponível: " .. id .. " (" .. status.Name .. ")")
				end
			end)
		end)
	end)
end

function Audio.Play(name, pitchMultiplier)
	local cue = Config.Cues[name]
	if not cue or not Audio.root or Audio.muted then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (Audio.last[name] or -math.huge) < cue.cooldown then return end
	Audio.last[name] = now
	for i = #Audio.voices, 1, -1 do
		if not Audio.voices[i].Parent then table.remove(Audio.voices, i) end
	end
	if #Audio.voices >= Config.MaxVoices then table.remove(Audio.voices, 1):Destroy() end
	local sound = Audio.templates[cue.id]:Clone()
	sound.Name = name
	sound.Volume = cue.volume
	sound.PlaybackSpeed = cue.pitch * (pitchMultiplier or 1)
	sound.Parent = Audio.root
	table.insert(Audio.voices, sound)
	sound:Play()
	sound.Ended:Once(function() sound:Destroy() end)
	task.delay(5, function() if sound.Parent then sound:Destroy() end end)
	return sound
end

function Audio.Charge(power)
	if power >= 1 then
		if not Audio.full then
			Audio.full = true
			Audio.StopCharge()
			Audio.full = true
			Audio.Play("Charged")
		end
	elseif not Audio.full then
		if not Audio.charging then
			Audio.charging = true
			Audio.chargeVoice = Audio.Play("Charge")
		end
		if Audio.chargeVoice and Audio.chargeVoice.Parent then
			Audio.chargeVoice.PlaybackSpeed = Config.Cues.Charge.pitch * (1 + power * 0.45)
		end
	end
end

function Audio.StopCharge()
	Audio.charging = false
	Audio.full = false
	for _, voice in ipairs(Audio.voices) do
		if voice.Parent and voice.Name == "Charge" then voice:Destroy() end
	end
	Audio.chargeVoice = nil
end

function Audio.Reward(golden)
	Audio.Play(golden and "Rare" or "Win")
	if golden then
		local generation = Audio.generation
		for i = 1, 3 do
			task.delay(0.35 + i * 0.13, function()
				if generation == Audio.generation then Audio.Play("Sparkle", 1 + i * 0.12) end
			end)
		end
	end
end

function Audio.SetMuted(muted)
	Audio.muted = muted
	if Audio.group then Audio.group.Volume = muted and 0 or Config.MasterVolume end
end

function Audio.Destroy()
	Audio.generation += 1
	Audio.StopCharge()
	if Audio.root then Audio.root:Destroy() end
	Audio.root, Audio.group = nil, nil
	Audio.templates, Audio.voices, Audio.last = {}, {}, {}
end
return Audio

local Layout = {}
function Layout.Resolve(view, touch)
	local w, h = math.max(280, view.X), math.max(200, view.Y)
	local narrow = w < 560
	local short = h < 430
	local margin = short and 10 or 16
	local desktop = not touch and w >= 1000 and h >= 560
	local slot = short and 60 or 76
	local reserve = touch and not narrow and math.clamp(w * 0.17, 110, 170) or margin
	local centerWidth = math.min(610, w - reserve * 2)
	local panelHeight = short and 108 or 126
	local bottom = margin + slot + 12
	-- Em retrato, deixar os dois polegares livres abaixo da disputa.
	if touch and narrow then bottom = math.max(bottom, 176) end
	return {
		width = w, height = h, margin = margin, narrow = narrow, short = short,
		desktop = desktop, touch = touch, slot = slot,
		bag = short and 64 or (narrow and 68 or 86),
		centerWidth = centerWidth, captureHeight = panelHeight,
		captureBottom = bottom, chargeBottom = bottom,
		resourceMode = desktop and "stack" or (narrow and "narrow" or "row"),
		resourceHeight = short and 44 or 52,
	}
end

function Preview.new(player)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = "PreviaFerramenta"
	part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanTouch, part.CanQuery = true, false, false, false
	part.Material, part.Transparency, part.CastShadow = Enum.Material.Neon, 1, false
	part.Parent = workspace
	return setmetatable({player = player, part = part}, Preview)
end
function Preview:Resolve(ray)
	local character = self.player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local world = workspace:FindFirstChild("HuntACreature")
	local island = world and world:FindFirstChild("IlhaCaca")
	local ground = island and island:FindFirstChild("Gramado")
	if not ray or not root or not ground then return nil, "Mire no chão perto de você." end
	local effects = world:FindFirstChild("EfeitosDeCaca")
	local wild = island:FindFirstChild("CriaturasSelvagens")
	local excluded = {character, self.part}
	if effects then table.insert(excluded, effects) end
	if wild then table.insert(excluded, wild) end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType, params.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, excluded
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(ray.origin, ray.direction * 150, params)
	if not hit then return nil, "Mire no chão perto de você." end
	local occupied = {}
	if effects then
		for _, part in ipairs(effects:GetChildren()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") and part:GetAttribute("HuntingTool") then table.insert(occupied, part) end
		end
	end
	local position, reason = Placement.Resolve(hit.Position, root.Position, ground, params, occupied)
	return position, reason, hit.Position
end
function Preview:Update(id, ray, unavailable)
	local position, reason, hit = self:Resolve(ray)
	local valid = position ~= nil and not unavailable
	if hit then
		local width = id == "Isca" and 1.2 or 3
		self.part.Size = Vector3.new(width, 0.12, width)
		self.part.Position = position or hit + Vector3.new(0, C.Placement.Height, 0)
		self.part.Color = valid and Color3.fromRGB(90, 235, 150) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 90)
		self.part.Transparency = 0.4
	else self:Hide() end
	return unavailable or reason or "Local livre • clique / R2 / Posicionar"
end
function Preview:Hide() self.part.Transparency = 1 end
function Preview:Destroy() self.part:Destroy() end
return Preview

  return
 end
 if action~="CollectionAction" or type(args)~="table" then return end
 if now-request.lastAction<0.15 then return end
 request.lastAction=now
 local p=Profiles:Get(player)

 if args.revision~=p.revision then notice(player,"A coleção mudou. Confira e tente novamente."); publish(player); return end
 if type(args.action)~="string" or type(args.id)~="string" or #args.id>100 then return end
 local ok,message
 if args.action=="Use" then
  ok,message=huntingTools:Use(player,args.id,args.position)
 elseif not busy(player) then
  if args.action=="Buy" and not near(player,presentation.shop,C.Shop.Distance) then notice(player,"Aproxime-se da loja no hub."); return end
  if args.action=="Upgrade" then
   local def=C.Upgrades[args.id]
   local group=def and C.UpgradeGroups[def.Group]
   if not group or not aliveRoot(player) then return end
   if group.Anchor then
    local base=baseOf(player)
    if not base or not near(player,base:FindFirstChild(group.Anchor),group.Distance) then notice(player,group.Hint); return end
   end
  end
  if args.action=="Install" or args.action=="Swap"

   local base=baseOf(player)

  end
  ok,message=Profiles:Change(player,function(nextProfile) return Data.Action(nextProfile,args.action,args,C.Rotation(os.time())) end)
 else message="Conclua a caça ou saia do treino primeiro." end
 notice(player,message)
 if ok then remote:FireClient(player,"ActionFeedback",args.action) end
 publish(player)
end)

   publish(player)
  end
 end

  elseif Profiles.sessions[player] then

 end
